_comment: VHS Load Video (VideoHelperSuite) as a workflow's own source video. Media is normally exposed by the node that imports it (a `references` collection), but a source loader whose outputs fan out — frames to the processing chain, audio and video_info to the output — has no single importing node, so its `video` input is exposed here directly: /object_info marks it uploadable, which gives the field the video upload dropzone (offline, the `video` in its name does). Loaders a reference collection wires (MiniMax H3's reference videos) are consumed by that collection and never reach this entry. The frame options are the loader's own trim/decimate settings; custom width/height stay as exported.
